source: micro_v3/out_overlap.jsonl (Blackwell GPU 1, 40 configurations of a synthetic memory-phase / compute-phase kernel); median overlap fraction over configurations with 8 or more phase pairs, 1 and 4 waves
overlap_definition: alpha = (Tm + Tc - T) / (Tm + Tc - max(Tm, Tc)); 0 = different blocks' phases fully serialised, 1 = fully overlapped
extrapolation: clamped to the measured range (no value above 6 resident blocks is measured)
